thread:
release-bot: Preflight check FAILED for release stable@v2.3.1 -> production-us-west. Blocked: 3 failing checks: integration-tests, db-migration-smoke, license-scan. Greenlight withheld. Tag: stable@v2.3.1-rc4. Deploy ID: dpl-2376543210. Details: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/2376543210 :warning:
olivia: On it. Which tests failed? can someone paste the failing test IDs?
ci-bot: integration-tests: 43/50 passed. Failures in `user-session-consistency` and `streaming-timeout`. db-migration-smoke: migration 2026_03_18 failed on staging replica. license-scan: found unapproved dependency `legacy-license-lib` in bundle.
matt: Ok. For the migration failure — looks like a locking issue on the replica, seen before. We can attempt a targeted rerun of the migration smoke job after clearing the lock. Suggest `./infra/ops clear-lock --db replica-west && ci rerun migration-smoke`
tia: :thinking_face: Hotfix vs delay? If license-scan is the blocker, we might need to roll the offending package out or patch the bundle. That could take >1h. Do we have to keep the RC pinned?
olivia: We can't unblock prod without license ok. But we can still ship a config-only patch to avoid the dep if it's feature-flagged. Sam — decision?
sam: @olivia @matt @tia Proposal: 1) Abort release now and pin prod to `stable@v2.3.0` to avoid partial rollout. 2) Start emergency branch to strip `legacy-license-lib` from bundle and run full preflight in parallel. ETA for hotfix 60-90m. Any objections?
matt: I'll prep the rollback pin. Command to pin: `releasectl pin --env prod --tag stable@v2.3.0 --note 'preflight failures 2376543210'`
tia: I'll start the hotfix branch and open PR w/ patch + CI. Assign to @olivia for review. I'll also queue the db lock clearance for the replica.
olivia: Ack. I'll review ASAP. If hotfix passes preflight, can we do a limited traffic rollout to 10% before full greenlight?
sam: Yes. Plan: pin prod -> start hotfix branch -> run preflight -> if all green, canary 10% then 100%. @release-bot, mark release as blocked and note manual pin planned.
release-bot: Status updated: release blocked, pinned target set to `stable@v2.3.0`. Notifications sent to oncall and security. Deploy ID dpl-2376543210. Re-run hooks: `ci rerun --jobs integration-tests,license-scan,migration-smoke` when ready.
ci-bot: Queued rerun for specified jobs on branch `hotfix/remove-legacy-license` once PR is open. Current ETA for job queue: ~12 minutes.
olivia: :thumbsup: I'll post an update to #customer-ops to delay the release window and note the rollback if customers ask.
matt: Keeping logs here: `s3://redwood-logs/dpl-2376543210/*.log` — share any failing stack traces and I'll triage.
tia: FYI: if hotfix fails, fallback is to do a manual artifact rebuild without the package and re-run smoke. We need to be ready to abort the rollback if that causes more risk.
sam: Good call. I'll write the rollback runbook steps and post here by +10m. For now, team move to hotfix track. Thanks.
olivia: Noted. Moving to thread: #eng-ops if we need infra help.
